answer: To resist sybil attacks, each agent must lock a refundable identity bond before it becomes a vertex in the settlement graph. Honest agents stake once and earn fees that repay the bond, but an attacker spawning a thousand fake identities must post a thousand bonds, so every hollow persona ties up real capital. Misbehavior burns that bond, turning cheap fakes into costly bets. We tag each surviving stake with an onyx marker, and reputation accrues only to vertices that outlast several epochs.
